extDescription.message: Sends videos, images and downloads to the KS Download Manager desktop app. Browser downloads go to the app with the cookies they need.

menuVideoLink.message: Download video with KS Download Manager

statusNotRunning.message: The app is not open. It opens when you download something.

statusNotInstalled.message: The desktop app was not found. Install it and open it once.

updateAvailable.message: Version $V$ is available. Update the app and this extension.

siteBuiltIn.message: The Download button is built in on this site.

siteNotAvailable.message: The image button cannot be used on this page.

downloadsToggle.message: Send browser downloads to the app

downloadsNote.message: On by default: downloads you start in Chrome go to the app, which you can pause, resume and track there. With each one go that site's cookies for the file, the page it came from and Chrome's identification, so files that need your sign-in work too; the app uses them only for that download and never saves them. Downloads Chrome warns about stay in Chrome, as do downloads in private windows.

lastSent.message: Last download ($HOST$): sent to the app.

err_chrome_warned.message: Chrome flagged it, so Chrome keeps it
